text:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — NeonHealth wants SOC2 artifacts + a pen-test attestation to close the POC MSA. They also asked if we can do staging IP allowlist, short-lived credentials for engineers, and if CMK is possible just for the 30-day POC.

Tom (Solutions Engineer): We can provide a redacted SOC2 artifact bundle (summary, control matrix, evidence index) under NDA. For engineering access we usually do ephemeral creds + workspace-level RBAC. Staging IP allowlist is fine — need CIDRs.

Ravi (Security): Clarifying pen-test attestation: we issue a signed attestation letter stating an external pentest was performed on <date> and whether any critical/major findings exist. We do NOT share full vendor reports unless there's a formal data-sharing agreement. Legal requires the customer org name and a POC scope statement.

Maya (AE): They said "technical team needs the full report to complete their risk questionnaire" — any flexibility?

Iris (Legal): We can offer a redacted excerpt of the report in exceptional cases, but that requires a data disclosure addendum and exec approval. It's a few days to route. Recommend offering the attestation + control mapping first.

Tom (Solutions Engineer): Regarding CMK: hosted customers cannot BYOK for tenant separation. Dedicated or Private supports customer-managed keys (KMS). For a short-term POC, Dedicated can be provisioned but there is lead time ~7-14 days plus infra validation. Pricing delta depends on GPU footprint; rough POC band is $12k2k for small-medium GPU config.

Maya (AE): They want an answer today on whether CMK is possible for a 30-day POC to include in procurement paperwork.

Ravi (Security): Short answer: yes, but only on Dedicated/Private. If they cannot commit to Dedicated, we can propose strong encryption at-rest with our KMS and strict access controls as compensating controls.

Tom (Solutions Engineer): If they do Dedicated for 30 days, ops will need a signed order form + billing contact. Also will open an infra ticket for provisioning.

Maya (AE): OK I'm collecting: 1) exact customer legal name for attestation, 2) staging CIDRs, 3) whether the POC will process PHI/PCI, 4) procurement flexibility on Dedicated commitment.

OpsBot: Presales ticket created: https://redwood.example.com/presales/29876. Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted), attestation_template.docx.

Iris (Legal): If they request the vendor report, ask them to sign the disclosure addendum (I can drop the doc). Turnaround for the addendum + redaction review is typically 5 business days.

Ravi (Security): Also note: if they want VPC peering instead of allowlist, that requires network review and longer lead time. Ask them which they prefer.

Maya (AE): Got it. I'll push the four asks and flag the vendor-report path as slower/conditional. Will update here when they respond.

Tom (Solutions Engineer): If they send CIDRs, I'll prepare an allowlist playbook and ephemeral creds instructions for their engineers.

Maya (AE): Thanks all :pray:
